thread:
alix: Reminder: MerchantCo pilot kickoff tomorrow. Need final POC acceptance criteria, golden prompts, and answers to KMS/pricing questions by 4pm.

marta: Acceptance criteria: 3 journeys (core, degraded input, hallucination case). Golden set: 20 canonical + 5 adversarial. Include expected output and manual-review tags.

samir: Use compact JSONL for goldens; include weights and failure_tags. Scoring: 0-1 per example, composite = 0.6 exactness, 0.3 factuality, 0.1 safety. Gate: mean >= 0.8 with 0 critical fails.

priya: Merchant asked about customer-managed keys on hosted tenants. Current note: hosted supports external KMS integration but not per-tenant CMKs; Private can have CMKs. Also confirm log retention: Hosted default 1 year, Dedicated configurable.

carl-sales: Pricing ask: example for 3-week burst vs immediate Dedicated conversion. I'll draft a one-pager with a placeholder burst estimate to share.

security-bot: Questionnaire received. Auto-scan flagged per-tenant CMK request and 5-year retention ask (outside default).

alix: Timeline: finalize goldens by 2pm, run baseline tonight, assemble pre-call deck at 5pm. Actions: Marta=goldens, Samir=baseline perf, Priya=security answers, Carl=pricing note.

marta: Uploading goldens to drive now.

carl-sales: Shared draft pricing link in drive (placeholder).

alix: Thanks team — will close thread at 4:15 if no blockers. :thumbsup:
